title: Review Proposal Contract
purpose: Defines the canonical repository-generic review-proposal structure and its subordinate presentation adapters.

review_fields.label: Governing issue
review_fields.description: Record the governing issue URL or issue number.

review_fields.label: Summary
review_fields.description: Summarize what changed, why, and any specification or generated-artifact effects.
review_fields.placeholder: Summarize the change and note any authority or artifact impact.

review_fields.label: Validation
review_fields.description: List the validation commands run and the results observed. Exact-revision evidence may be supplied by GitHub metadata or linked validation records. If the review-proposal body states a revision-specific fact such as a head SHA, commit count, or exact-head status, that claim shall describe the current proposed revision and shall be refreshed or removed after any new commit before acceptance.
review_fields.placeholder:
scripts/validate
Results and any noteworthy revision evidence.

review_fields.label: Review focus
review_fields.description: Direct human semantic review to the areas where judgment is needed, including whether the proposed change preserves controlling authority and whether relevant validation behavior under-enforces, overreaches, or enforces semantics that conflict with controlling authority.
review_fields.placeholder: Identify semantic-review focus, authority-sensitive judgment, and any validation behavior requiring human review.

review_fields.label: Scope notes
review_fields.description: State exclusions, limitations, deferred work, or post-merge requirements. Use None when there are none.
review_fields.placeholder: Write None when there are no exclusions or deferred items.

normative_requirements.text: The repository shall define exactly one canonical review-proposal contract for bounded reviewed changes.

The canonical `review_fields` collection in this specification is normative structured contract data under repo.authority-model. Evidence already captured by GitHub metadata, automated checks, the governing issue, or linked validation records may remain outside the visible PR body.
The canonical review-proposal contract shall distinguish reviewer-facing PR-body content from metadata and linked evidence.

Acceptance evidence is revision-specific: review conclusions, approval state, required evidence, and any freshness-sensitive claims used for acceptance shall correspond to the exact revision proposed for merge; a later material revision invalidates stale acceptance evidence until it is re-established for that revision.

Semantic preservation from normalized predecessor requirements:
- REPO-RP-005: New commits shall invalidate prior exact-head validation or acceptance evidence until checks are repeated.
- REPO-RP-008: Acceptance shall apply only to the exact proposed revision.
- REPO-RP-017: Reviewer-facing revision-specific claims in a review proposal shall not contradict the current proposed revision or authoritative validation evidence; after the proposed head changes, any such mutable claim shall be refreshed or removed before acceptance.
Merge shall not be treated as proof of successful post-merge validation.
The review proposal shall not use automatic issue-closing syntax when the governing issue requires post-merge validation before closure.
Empty placeholders shall not satisfy required review-proposal fields.

When creating or updating a GitHub pull request, the chatbot shall load and use .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md as the PR-body template, and shall treat it as a subordinate adapter to repo.review-proposal rather than as the governing contract.
The GitHub pull request template shall omit internal field IDs, input types, placeholders, and schema-projection details from visible body content.
